outcome: Clinical course of Cesarean scar pregnancy
Gestational age at time of procedure
cohort: 50 patients with first-trimester cesarean scar pregnancy
finding: In selected hemodynamically stable patients with first-trimester Cesarean scar pregnancy, transabdominal ultrasound-guided suction curettage was associated with shorter postoperative hospital stays compared to abdominal hysterotomy, while no significant differences were observed in other clinical outcomes.
